description: This file defines a FastAPI application for a resume matching API. It includes endpoints for uploading resume files (PDF/DOCX), extracting key information (name, contact, skills, experience, education), and comparing resume content against a provided job description to compute a keyword match score. The code also contains utility functions for text extraction, parsing, and keyword matching.

classes.name: ExtractedData
classes.description: Data model for extracted resume fields such as name, contact, skills, experience, and education.

classes.name: MatchResponse
classes.description: Response model for the resume matching endpoint. Contains score, matched/missing keywords, summary, feedback, and extracted data.

methods.name: str _clean_text(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace and case in text for matching.

methods.name: str _extract_text_from_pdf(file_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text content from a PDF file in-memory using PyPDF2.

methods.name: str _extract_text_from_docx(file_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts text content from a DOCX file in-memory using python-docx.

methods.name: str _extract_name(text: str)
methods.description: Heuristic to extract candidate's name from text.

methods.name: str _extract_contact(text: str)
methods.description: Extracts contact info (email and phone) from text.

methods.name: str _section_text(text: str, start_keywords: List[str], stop_keywords: List[str])
methods.description: Extracts text between section headers based on start and stop keywords.

methods.name: List[str] _extract_skills(text: str)
methods.description: Extracts skills from specific sections or general text heuristics.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize_keywords(s: str)
methods.description: Tokenizes input text into normalized keyword phrases.

methods.name: Set[str] _keyword_sets_from_job_description(jd_text: str)
methods.description: Generates a set of relevant keywords from a job description.

methods.name: Tuple[float,List[str],List[str]] _compute_match(resume_text: str, jd_text: str)
methods.description: Computes a keyword overlap score and lists matched/missing keywords.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify the service is running.

methods.name: match_resume( resume: UploadFile | None = File( default=None, description="The resume file in PDF or DOCX format (preferred field name: 'resume')." ), file: UploadFile | None = File( default=None, description="Alternative field name for the resume file (if frontend sends 'file')." ), job_description: str = Form(..., description="The job description text to match against"), )
methods.description: Endpoint to process uploaded resume files, extract info, and match against job description.
